Use case: stylized-concept. Edit and expand the referenced SIX-pose atlas into a NEW SIXTEEN-frame animation atlas of the SAME character. Reference is identity/costume/style lock only, NOT layout. Output ONE square 1536x1536 PNG with actual transparent RGBA background. EXACT FOUR columns and FOUR rows, equal square cells; NO titles or grid lines. Each row contains FOUR DISTINCT frames in the specified order. Original Chinese absurd meme 2D fighting game, chibi three-head-tall adult male, crisp hand ink dark navy outlines and clean anime cel shading, orthographic side view slightly three-quarter to reveal face, all figures face SCREEN RIGHT. Consistent costume, hair, face, props and body scale across all 16 frames. CRITICAL: sprites must be small and separated: each entire figure and ALL props fit in the central 68% of its own cell; at least 16% transparent margins on EVERY edge. Standing feet at 80% of cell height, head about 25%; crouch must physically bend knees lower head without shrinking skull or torso, falling/lying figures keep same anatomical scale. Do not fill cells with oversized characters. Actual transparent gaps between ALL frames, no overlap, floor, shadows, scenery, blurry color halos, checkerboard, text, labels, letters, numbers, aura, motion blur or detached effects. Exactly two arms/two legs, same clothing all frames. Preserve the funny personality while making authentic clear fighting movements. 
IDENTITY: 甲方: fat male client boss, slick short black hair with curl, tiny rectangular glasses, burgundy suit jacket, cream shirt stretched over belly, gold tie, navy trousers, black dress shoes. Carries revision-paper stack with abstract red marks and red rubber stamp. Papers may be tucked at belt during two-handed moves, never duplicate hands.
MOVE IDENTITY: heavy: exaggerated giant right fist drives forward; special: lift and swing oversized red rubber stamp down to right; uppercut: bare fist rising high while belly twists; throw: clutch with both empty hands then turn and toss imagined opponent behind, no victim drawn.
FRAME ORDER:
ROW 1 RUN: left foot forward stride; legs crossing in passing; right foot forward stride; second passing pose. Arms counter-swing, torso leans forward, real different footfalls. ROW 2 JUMP: deeply bent knees takeoff anticipation; airborne knees tucked and arms up; descending body with one leg extended down; deep two-knee landing compression. ROW 3 LOW: deep crouch ready on two bent legs; deep crouch guard with raised forearm/prop shield; low straight punch from crouch towards right; low extended sweeping leg near ground with bent support leg. ROW 4 REACTION: recoil from hit, head and chest jerk back; airborne knocked-back pose bent limbs; LYING FLAT on back on ground with head left and feet right, horizontal body; one knee grounded pushing up to rise. All rows must show genuine pose differences, not duplicates.

repairs.prompt: Edit this exact 16-frame atlas to fix CLIPPING AND MARGINS ONLY. Preserve the same adult chibi client-boss identity, same sixteen poses, same row order, costume, linework and props. Keep four columns and four rows. Uniformly shrink all sprites by 25 percent and reposition them to the centers of their own cells, leaving large fully transparent margins on all sides. MOST IMPORTANT: top row third pose has the red rubber stamp clipped against the TOP EDGE of the canvas; reconstruct the entire stamp head and keep it fully visible with at least 50 pixels of empty space above it. Nothing may touch any outer image border or neighboring sprite. Keep all characters the same body scale relative to each other, including crouched and airborne poses. Actual RGBA transparent background, no new background, no checkerboard, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no extra figures. Original image pixels are a style and layout reference; do not repeat cropped top stamp. Output a square 4x4 character sprite atlas.

Edit the TOP ROW ONLY of this exact 4-column 4-row 16-frame transparent sprite atlas. Preserve all twelve poses in rows 2,3,4 unchanged, same old-man identity, bald crown, gray moustache, white tank top, blue floral shorts, green slippers, orange extension cord, ivory power strip and blue ethernet cord. FIX RUN CYCLE: top row currently shows almost the same stride four times. Replace top row with four CLEARLY DIFFERENT RUNNING frames facing RIGHT: frame1 LEFT leg reaches forward and RIGHT leg stretches backward; frame2 BOTH LEGS PASS below hips, one knee raised, near vertical shin, compact silhouette; frame3 RIGHT leg reaches forward and LEFT leg stretches backward (opposite arm swing to frame1); frame4 other passing pose, both feet near each other below body, knees bent. Show visible alternating knee positions, arm swings and body compression, not four copies of a split-leg pose. Keep top-row body scale the same as current row, all foot and prop pixels within their own columns, transparent gaps. Preserve entire character and slippers. Real RGBA transparency, no shadows, backgrounds, checkerboard, labels, text, grid or extra figures.
